inst.picker.count: {n, plural, one {# instrument} other {# instruments}} of {total} · one card per type
inst.picker.choose: Choose an instrument from the list.
inst.picker.no_keys: No key is associated with this instrument yet.
inst.picker.missing_alt: Accidentals missing from this layout: {list}{more, select, yes {…} other {}} — songs that use them will be flagged before playback.
inst.picker.percussion_warn: Percussion: the mapping from the sources does not say which strike produces which pitch. A suitable test is required before you can play.
inst.picker.layouts_hint: Choose the same layout in the game as here. They do not use the same keys.
inst.picker.full_title: Check every mapping, in groups of three, to earn “Confirmed on this computer”
inst.picker.hint_community: The key tables come from community projects. They have not been tested in Heartopia from this computer: the status says so for each instrument.
inst.picker.hint_json: Profile in JSON format: only the data is read, no imported content is executed. A profile verified elsewhere becomes “to verify” again here.
inst.picker.stop_before_import: Stop playback before importing a profile.
inst.picker.import_html:
Choose a .json file exported by DodoTopia. The keys of “{name}” will be replaced.

A profile verified on another computer becomes “to verify” again here: a validation done elsewhere proves nothing about this installation.
inst.picker.replace_html:
This instrument uses keys you entered yourself. Changing the layout replaces them with the documented table of “{layout}”.

Your customisation will be lost.
inst.status.blocked: Keys to set up before you can play.
inst.status.provenance_quick_tested: Quick test passed on this computer (a sample, not a full validation)
inst.status.provenance_custom: Keys entered on this computer, not verified in the game
inst.status.provenance_documented: Documented by a community source, not verified in the game
inst.status.provenance_unknown: Unknown: no source documents the keys of this instrument
inst.keys.display_hint_html: Layout used for display: {kbl}{detected, select, yes { (detected)} other {}}. DodoTopia sends a key position to the game: changing this value changes the label shown, not what is sent.
inst.keys.no_keys: No key is associated with this instrument: its keys are not documented anywhere.
inst.keys.shift_warn: “Key sending” is set to “Displayed letter” and your keyboard is AZERTY: digits need Shift and may not get through. Switch back to “Position” in Settings › Music and audio › Advanced.
inst.keys.full_hint_html: Full validation goes over every mapping again in the game, in groups of three. It is the only procedure that grants “Confirmed on this computer”: a quick test is not enough.
inst.keys.adv_summary: Advanced: MIDI, reference position and key sending
inst.keys.adv_convention_html: Display convention: C4 = MIDI 60. The “position” column is the name of the key on a US QWERTY keyboard: this is the name DodoTopia sends to the game, whatever your layout.
inst.keys.send_mode_html: Key sending: {mode, select, vk {Displayed letter (vk)} other {Position (scancode)}}. With “Position”, the keyboard layout makes no difference to what the game receives. With “Displayed letter”, an AZERTY keyboard changes digits and punctuation: it is the only case where the “Shift” column matters.
inst.wizard.conflict_dup: Already used by {notes}: two notes cannot share a key.
inst.wizard.conflict_uninjectable: This key cannot be sent to the game.
inst.wizard.conflict_hotkey_hard: Taken by the “{label}” shortcut ({key}). Choose another key: a stop shortcut is never removed for a mapping.
inst.wizard.conflict_shift: On AZERTY with “Displayed letter” sending, this digit needs Shift: the game may receive nothing.
inst.wizard.key_rejected: This key cannot be sent to the game: use a letter, a digit or a punctuation key from the main keyboard.
inst.wizard.open_lead_html: Open {name} in Heartopia and stand in front of its in-game keyboard.
inst.wizard.open_notice: Choosing an instrument here equips nothing in Heartopia: DodoTopia only sends keys to the game window. Before the test in step 4, the instrument must already be open in the game.
inst.wizard.open_percussion: This instrument is a percussion. The sources give a MIDI mapping, but nothing proves which strike it produces: the test in step 4 will ask you which strike you heard.
inst.wizard.open_hint: You can go back or cancel at any time: the saved profile is only replaced at the last step.
inst.wizard.layout_intro_html: Look at the instrument’s keyboard in the game and choose the layout that looks like it. Two 15-note layouts do not use the same keys: compare the rows.
inst.wizard.layout_undocumented: No source documents the keys of this instrument. The layouts below are candidates: note down what you see, then correct key by key at the next step.
inst.wizard.layout_hint: Choose the same layout in Heartopia as here. The exact location of this setting in the game is not confirmed: DodoTopia will not give you a made-up menu path.
inst.wizard.bind_intro_html: Click a key in the table, then press the key you use in the game for that note. The key’s position is what is kept, not the letter printed on it.
inst.wizard.bind_hint: Escape cancels the current capture, Backspace clears the mapping. Nothing is sent to the game and global shortcuts are disconnected during capture.
inst.wizard.bind_count: {bound} / {total, plural, one {# note mapped} other {# notes mapped}}
inst.wizard.test_intro_html: The test sends at most 3 keys to Heartopia. DodoTopia minimises its window, counts down, then sends. The Stop the test button below and the stop shortcut ({key}) cut the sending immediately.
inst.wizard.test_notice: Heartopia must be in the foreground with {name} open. Choosing the instrument in DodoTopia does not equip it in the game.
inst.wizard.full_progress_html: Full validation: {done, plural, one {# mapping verified} other {# mappings verified}} of {bound}. Each pass resumes where you stopped, in groups of three keys. The “Confirmed on this computer” status is only written once all mappings are verified.
inst.wizard.test_failed: {message} No conclusion is drawn from it: run it again whenever you want.
inst.wizard.test_failed_default: The test did not run to the end.
inst.wizard.heard_percussion_hint: On a percussion, the question is not “was it a C?” but which strike sounded.
inst.wizard.heard_hint: The “what did you hear?” question only appears once the keys have actually been sent: DodoTopia never asks you to validate a test that did not happen.
inst.wizard.group_ok: Group verified: {done, plural, one {# mapping} other {# mappings}} of {bound}.{all, select, yes { All mappings are verified: the profile will be saved as “Confirmed on this computer”.} other { Continue with the next group.}}
inst.wizard.quick_ok: Quick test passed · partial verification. Three keys do not prove the {n} mappings: full validation is still to do.
inst.wizard.answer_no: Answer saved: the profile will stay “custom keys · to verify”. Go back to the previous step to correct it.
inst.wizard.skip_hint: You can also skip this step: the profile will be saved as “to verify”.
inst.wizard.save_conflicts_notice: {n, plural, one {# conflict to fix} other {# conflicts to fix}} before saving: {notes}. Go back to the “Keys” step. No stop shortcut will be removed to accept this mapping.
inst.wizard.save_hint: This status describes what was actually done on this computer. It never says the profile was validated in Heartopia until every key has been verified one by one.
inst.wizard.stop_before_test: Stop playback before testing the keys.
inst.wizard.cancel_html: The keys entered in the wizard will be lost. The profile already saved for this instrument stays unchanged.
inst.wizard.stop_before_setup: Stop playback before setting up the keys.
